row.name: BILL Holdings Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)
checks.note: today would be breakout 6 of this move

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=20 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=1 giveback=0.3 tightness=0.8 base_volume_vs_leg=0.89 base_volume_vs_avg=0.95
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 2.5% vs its 20-SMA, -0.2% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The checklist flags this as breakout 6 of the same move, and the chart confirms it: the shaded base sits inside a 20-session sideways chop that is itself the sixth push off the June low, with the prior four breakouts working only 1 of 4 times. The base bars inside the box are wide and overlapping — multiple red and green candles of similar size with long wicks — showing no real tightening, and the burst bar's 5.12% gain is modest against a 4.2% range that is not even the widest of the last five bars (RE: FAIL). A sixth breakout of a 60% move with a 1-for-4 track record and a loose, wide base is not a momentum burst setup; it is late-trend noise.
claude.key_risk: Six breakouts into the same 60% move with prior attempts succeeding only once means the odds of a sustained 3–5 day burst are materially worse than the base rate the strategy requires.
claude.entry_note: Skip at the open if price gaps above the entry ceiling, opens below the burst-day close (~47.30), or shows a weak first 30 minutes with volume below the prior session's pace.

row.summary: BILL: +5.1% on 1.4× volume out of a base 12.2% deep. skip 8.5, 5 of 6 criteria.
